amendment_reason: Replace the earlier eligibility-filtered six-persona binding for future execution with an outcome-blinded maximin binding over declared non-sensitive behavioral/cognitive dimensions. Historical binding remains unchanged.

pilot.purpose: pipeline/integrity qualification only; A/B semantic effect is not a pilot promotion criterion

behavior_profiles.mapping_rule: Within a paired A/B comparison, persona, behavioral profile, replicate, case and seed are identical; only protocol section order differs.
behavior_profiles.probability_claim: Stress assumptions, not fitted human probabilities.
behavior_profiles.timing_claim: Synthetic navigation steps are not human time.

gates.model_qualification: exactly 16/16 frozen operational qualification cases pass; no partial credit
gates.persona_verification: all six exact persona files load and render natively without fallback
gates.pilot: 24/24 terminal sessions accounted for; exact actor/material/persona identities; zero hidden retries; zero answer repair; no evaluator-key leakage; runtime feasibility established
gates.formal_launch: pilot integrity gate PASS; semantic pilot A/B result ignored for launch decision
